title: Update on the Razer Creator Beta Program!
author: Razer-Plood
selftext:
I shared a post earlier about our new AI game development tools, and I wanted to add a bit more detail for those interested. 

We’re inviting developers and creators to join the **Razer Creator Beta Program**—a free trial where you can experiment with our upcoming AI-powered tools, share feedback, and help shape what we’re building.

A lot is still under embargo, so I can’t reveal everything yet, but I’m happy to answer what I can or send your questions with the right folks.

**Bonus:** Early adopters can unlock Razer gear (like mice and headsets) by completing a few simple tasks during the trial.

Sign up here: [https://rzr.to/creator](https://rzr.to/creator)
